δῦνε: δύνω, δύω — enter, go into; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδυνε): ’entered’
δῶμ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. sg., elided (δῶμ’ = δῶμα)
εἰδῇ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’who knows’
κάππεσε: καταπίπτω — fall down; aor. 3 sg., κατα- cut short and assimilated (κάππεσε = κατέπεσε)
καθέξει: κατέχω — hold down, cover, hold fast; fut. 3 sg. (καθ- from κατά before the rough breathing of ἕξει)
κεῖθεν: κεῖθεν — from there, thence; adv. (= ἐκεῖθεν, with -θεν ’from’)
λὶς: λίς — smooth, bare (of rock); adj., fem. nom. sg. (λὶς πέτρη ’smooth rock’)
μελέτω: μέλω — be a care, be a concern; pres. imper. 3 sg. impersonal: ’let it be a care’
μοίρῃ: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μοίρᾳ) · also in ἐν μοίρῃ, ’in due measure, rightly’ (ἐν μοίρῃ πέφαται ’has been slain deservedly’)
ναιέμεν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ναίειν): ’to inhabit’
παρεστάμεναι: παρίστημι — stand beside, be present to help; perf. inf. with pres. force, epic -μεναι (= Attic παρεστάναι)
παύετ: παύω — stop, make cease; mid. cease; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (παύετ’ = παύετο): ’was ceasing’
πολιὴν: πολιός — grey, hoary; adj., fem. acc. sg. (πολιὴν ἅλα ’the grey sea’)
φέρω: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. 1 sg. (or deliberative subj., same spelling): ’am I carrying / am I to carry’
φράσομαι: φράζω — point out; mid. note, take note of; fut. 1 sg. mid.: ’I shall take note’
ἀπηνέα: ἀπηνής — unkind, harsh, unfeeling; neut. acc. pl., substantival, uncontracted (= Attic ἀπηνῆ): ’unkind things’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν: ’unkind’ (ἀπηνέα θυμὸν ’an unkind heart’)
ἐθελήσει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; fut. 3 sg.
ἐκπάγλοις: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, dreadful, violent; masc./neut. dat. pl., agreeing with a neuter noun
ἐποιχόμενον: ἐποίχομαι — go up to, go round; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’going round’
ἐπότρυνον: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. imper. 2 sg. act. (pres. imper. would be ἐπότρυνε): ’urge, press’ · also impf. 1 sg./3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπώτρυνον)
ἐρινύες: Ἐρινύς — Erinys, Fury (avenging spirit); fem. nom. pl.
ἐτελέσθη: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been brought to pass’ · also aor. pass. 3 sg. with a neut. pl. subject, of time: ’were brought round to their end’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ἐτελέσθη)
ἠδέ: ἠδέ — and; epic conjunction, accented before an enclitic
ἠλίβατος: ἠλίβατος — towering, steep, sheer (sense of the epic word uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
ἧσ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἧσ’ = ἧσο)
ἵκωνται: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. subj. 3 pl. mid., after ὅτ’ ἄν: ’whenever they reach’
ὀτρύνοντος: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive with ἄκουσαν: ’heeded him urging’
ὁδόν: ὁδός — road, way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
